title: I have a mall/airport/ferry port in my dreams I call ‘Grand Dream Central’.
content: I seem to often ‘land’ there and can get from there to other parts of my dream landscape I call ‘the dreaming’ (a nod to Neil Gaiman). I almost always dream in the same world/landscape although go to different parts of it. They’re all connected. I could draw a map. There is a city partially built on ships out on a bay, with a neighbourhood on a hill stretching up from it, with no streets (you have to travel through back gardens to get anywhere) except for smaller ‘arty’ streets at the edges with cool shops and bars, there’s a plateau above where the rich people live and they have a man-made lake that has a path through it just under the water that lets you look like you’re walking on water…there’s an evergreen forest where these travelling market people live with their dogs, that’s beyond the plateau, there’s a waterfront walkway and wildlife preserve and there’s a massive wetland with an empty highway stretching for miles and miles over it. Back in the city there’s old streets and hotels with maze-like floors and interconnected rooms, half doors and hallways and stairs going nowhere, very ‘being john malkovitch-y’ , and there’s a big old Victorian house up on the plateau which I think may be my own psyche, similar maze-like rooms. Sometimes there are others in this world, sometimes not. The mall is in the city and it seems to encompass a airport/seaport as well. It is MASSIVE, and also maze like, although not as confusing as the hotel or the house.
